summary: Rounds backed Rick Scott's 2023 resolution adopting the IHRA definition, under which delegitimization of Israel is treated as antisemitism, and in April 2026 voted against resolutions to block roughly $450 million in weapons sales to Israel. While he expressed a desire to end suffering in Gaza and criticized Israel's strike in Qatar as undermining the peace process, he simultaneously affirmed Israel's right to target Hamas and reaffirmed America's commitment to stand with Israel after October 7.
